description: A score without a time signature at the beginning (but with <key> and <clef> elements). The second bar sets a 2/2 time signature with ‘print-object="no"’ for both staves, and the third bar sets a 4/4 time signature with ‘print-object="no"’ only for the lower staff. Whether a time signature is actually displayed at the very beginning (if there is no <time> element) is application-dependent.
warnings: part P1, measure 2: time print-object="no" is not represented; the meter remains visible when time signatures are shown.
part P1, measure 3, staff 1: staff-local time scope is not represented; the selected meter is applied globally.
part P1, measure 3, staff 2: staff-local time scope is not represented; the selected meter is applied globally.
part P1, measure 3, staff 2: time print-object="no" is not represented; the meter remains visible when time signatures are shown.
part P1, measure 3, staff 2: additional local time declaration is not represented; first meter retained.
